svg.title: Planck, ironbow, a die heat model and its Bessel profile
svg.desc: Blackbody spectra with the LWIR band, the ironbow palette and its luma, a simulated die heat field, and its point-source profile against K0.
svg.text: die (planned): from blackbody radiation to a screened heat equation
a blackbody exitance at 300 to 390 K
b ironbow, 30 to 105 C, and its luma
c heat field after 5 tau, one P-core busy
peak 76.4 C (ambient 34 C); schematic blocks, not to scale
d point-source profile against K0(r / lambda)
kappa and tau are the model's, not silicon's: real silicon spreads heat about 90 times faster per cell
